title: Fresh portal requests and complete publishing checks on supported targets
summary: Check 08 closes each portal request so its second fetch cannot reuse a socket from the previous staging process. Check 05 runs real Homebrew installation on both Mac arm64 and Linux x64, failing before services start when a supported target lacks brew. Journey phases, fixtures and actual install/version/cleanup assertions remain unchanged.
proves: On integrated source a94a183 plus the author changes, real checks 05 and 08 pass sequentially: two files and three tests in 276 seconds. The SDK installs from Verdaccio at the expected version; the Mac-arm64 Homebrew formula installs the real binary and its --version matches. Healthy and slow staging traffic, portal verdicts and spend-only stale assertions all pass across staging restarts. Linux x64 now requires the same authored Homebrew test; its execution remains the CI job’s proof. Cleanup leaves no Architect container, reserved listening socket, test tap/formula or worktree runtime process.
